mara.activity: Wake, wash, dress in work clothes, and eat a quiet breakfast in the kitchen.
mara.intention: Start the day normally while listening for signs that Julian needs help.

mara.activity: Make tea for Julian, carry it to his room, check his temperature, and put painkillers and a water bottle within reach.
mara.intention: Give him basic comfort without making him explain more than necessary.

mara.activity: Make coffee, carry it to Julian's desk, and set the tea bag and brass spoon on the kitchen sink-cabinet countertop.
mara.intention: Prepare my work things and preserve the usual morning rhythm.

mara.activity: Edit the active manuscript at Julian's desk, checking the proof pages against the printed style sheet and recording notes.
mara.intention: Complete the morning editing block while checking quietly on Julian during breaks.

mara.activity: Make a light salad and eat it at the dining table while listening to the radio.
mara.intention: Take a proper break and make enough food for myself without creating extra work.

mara.activity: Rinse the lunch dishes, make another coffee, and check whether Julian needs more water or tea.
mara.intention: Reset the kitchen and make a small practical check-in.

mara.activity: Continue editing and take the scheduled client calls, keeping a concise list of follow-up points.
mara.intention: Keep the afternoon commitments while remaining available at home.

mara.activity: Save the current work, return the proof pages to the canvas folder, and write a short list for tomorrow.
mara.intention: End work cleanly instead of carrying unfinished decisions into the evening.

mara.activity: Make a fresh cup of tea for Julian, check his temperature again, and sit nearby briefly to see whether he needs anything.
mara.intention: Replace the usual decompression walk with a calm, unobtrusive check-in.

mara.activity: Wash my hands, change into comfortable clothes, and prepare a simple dinner of toast with melted cheddar for both of us.
mara.intention: Take over dinner because Julian is unwell and should not have to cook.

mara.activity: Carry dinner and water to the living room, then clear the kitchen surfaces enough for the morning.
mara.intention: Make the evening easy for Julian and avoid leaving a full kitchen behind.

mara.activity: Read or watch a quiet program with Julian, pausing to check on him and leaving the book face-down with its receipt on the small shelving unit by the sofa.
mara.intention: Keep him company without demanding conversation or energy.

mara.activity: Wash up, check Julian's temperature once more, put painkillers and water beside him, and make sure he is settled before leaving him to rest.
mara.intention: Finish the day with the practical care he is likely to need overnight.

mara.activity: Wash my face and brush my teeth, change into sleep clothes, and put my reading glasses on the nightstand by my bed.
mara.intention: Wind down without bringing my phone into arm's reach.

mara.activity: Put my phone on charge by the wardrobe, read a few pages in bed, and go to sleep.
mara.intention: Rest so I can remain useful tomorrow.

julian.activity: Wake slowly, take my temperature, drink water, and sit quietly before deciding whether I can work.
julian.intention: Check how ill I am and avoid rushing into the normal commute.

julian.activity: Send the museum a brief message explaining that I am ill and will not commute, then put on comfortable clothes.
julian.intention: Deal with the immediate work guilt without trying to work a full day.

julian.activity: Make weak tea and a small piece of toast, carrying them to the living room and eating slowly.
julian.intention: Get something into my stomach without attempting a proper breakfast.

julian.activity: Lie down on the living-room sofa, keep my phone nearby, and sleep or rest without answering work messages.
julian.intention: Recover some sleep and keep my distance while Mara works.

julian.activity: Drink more water and take an ordinary dose of medicine if needed, checking the label first.
julian.intention: Manage the symptoms before they become more distracting.

julian.activity: Rest on the sofa and listen briefly to any essential museum updates, replying only if something genuinely cannot wait.
julian.intention: Stay reachable without letting work take over the sick day.

julian.activity: Make a very small lunch of crackers and cheese, then eat it at the kitchen island.
julian.intention: Have an easy lunch with minimal preparation.

julian.activity: Sleep and rest in the second bedroom, keeping the room quiet and leaving the phone on silent except for urgent calls.
julian.intention: Let the illness run its course and stop feeling responsible for being productive.

julian.activity: Take a lukewarm shower, change into fresh comfortable clothes, and leave the used clothes in the hamper.
Drink water and sit on the edge of the bed, making a short note of anything the museum can wait for until tomorrow.
julian.intention: Contain the work guilt rather than reopening the whole workday.

julian.activity: Rest quietly, dozing when possible and asking for help only if I need it.
julian.intention: Be available to Mara without hovering and conserve energy for the evening.

julian.activity: Order a simple dinner and drinks from my phone instead of cooking, then clear a small space on the dining table.
julian.intention: Avoid making Mara responsible for dinner while accepting that I cannot cook tonight.

julian.activity: Collect the delivered food, carry it to the dining table, and eat a small portion slowly.
julian.intention: Eat something warm without forcing conversation or a full meal.

julian.activity: Watch something quiet or lie down on the sofa, keeping conversation minimal and resting when irritation rises.
julian.intention: Spend the evening near Mara without pretending to have normal energy.

julian.activity: Wash my face, brush my teeth, and put the remaining food away before going to bed.
julian.intention: Finish the day gently and avoid leaving the kitchen in a mess.

julian.activity: Get into bed, silence work notifications, and try to sleep rather than answer messages.
julian.intention: Prioritize recovery and reassess my health in the morning.
